basis: Typical ranges from common New York agency practice (.claude/skills/industry/reference/standards.md §2, §4). Context for where a talent is usually filed, never a gate: agencies publish their own requirements, and those are evaluated separately.

boards.label: Fashion and editorial
boards.note: The narrowest physical standards in the industry.

boards.label: Runway
boards.note: Cast to sample sizes, so height is a hard requirement each season.

boards.label: Curve
boards.note: Sizes above sample size, with its own standards. Where curve starts varies by agency, so Pholio does not place you on size.

boards.label: Classic
boards.note: Talent in their 30s to 70s and up. Major commercial demand.

boards.label: Commercial
boards.note: Ads, catalogue and campaigns. A wide range of heights, ages and sizes.

boards.label: Lifestyle
boards.note: Relatable over extreme. A wide range of looks.

boards.label: E-comm
boards.note: Booked on fit to the brand's sample clothing.

boards.label: Fitness and athletic
boards.note: Athletic build matters more than height.

boards.label: Fit
boards.note: Booked on exact measurements to a brand's sample size.

boards.label: Parts
boards.note: Hands, feet, legs, hair or lips.
